text.textPath: [Arch Linux] Updating the system and praying glibc doesn't break the entire dependency graph.
[Arch Linux] Spending 14 uninterrupted hours configuring Hyprland animations just to open an empty terminal.
[Arch Linux] Compiling the Linux kernel from source to keep the bedroom warm during winter.
[Arch Linux] Explaining why systemd is an abomination to someone who just asked for directions to the cafeteria.
[Arch Linux] Running pacman -Syu with sweaty palms, 2% battery, and zero backups.
[Arch Linux] Rebuilding the entire world from source because one whitespace was added to configuration.nix.
[Arch Linux] Watching packages compile for 3 days on an Intel Celeron while questioning every life choice.
[Arch Linux] Using an ancient kernel tested by Neanderthals because stability is more important than oxygen.
[Arch Linux] Installing a 5MB container distro and realizing you can't even run bash or curl.
[Arch Linux] Trying to exit Vim by unplugging the PC from the wall socket and throwing it into a river.
[Arch Linux] Fixing a broken pipewire audio daemon by blindly toggling ALSA settings until sound comes out of the microphone.
[Arch Linux] Spending 6 hours debugging why wifi died only to realize the physical airplane mode switch was flipped.
[Arch Linux] Running sudo chmod -R 777 / and watching the OS immediately commit ritual suicide.
[Arch Linux] Writing a 200-line shell script to automate a task that takes 4 seconds to do manually.
[Arch Linux] Saying 'I use Arch btw' at a job interview for a non-technical accounting position.
[Arch Linux] Troubleshooting why the Bluetooth headset connects as an input device for the display brightness.
[Arch Linux] Debugging why the display manager crashed into an initramfs rescue shell after a minor wallpaper change.
[Arch Linux] Compiling a custom kernel module just to make the keyboard RGB pulse in sync with CPU thermal throttling.
[Arch Linux] Running neofetch in a transparent terminal with anime wallpaper to validate developer identity.
[Arch Linux] Disabling SELinux, setting AppArmor to permissive, and whispering 'security was an illusion anyway'.

[Windows 11] Forcing an automatic restart at 99% during an unsaved 4,000-line kernel compilation.
[Windows 11] Consuming 31.8 GB of 32 GB RAM just to idle an Ubuntu bash prompt running htop.
[Windows 11] Throwing DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL with a patronizing smiley face at 3:00 AM.
[Windows 11] Eating 85% CPU power scanning the node_modules directory you just cloned 12 seconds ago.
[Windows 11] Refusing to delete a 0-byte file because it is locked by an unnamed entity from another dimension.
[Windows 11] Telling you that you need administrator permissions from yourself to move a text file to the Desktop.
[Windows 11] Running TASKKILL /F /IM explorer.exe and suddenly the desktop vanishes into a pitch black void.
[Windows 11] Reinstalling the graphics driver 4 times because Windows Update quietly downgraded it to a 2019 OEM version.
[Windows 11] Spending 45 minutes searching for how to disable automatic restarts only to find Microsoft patched the registry workaround.
[Windows 11] Popping up a full-screen notification asking you to try Bing while you are defusing a production server incident.
[Windows 11] Taking 12 minutes to calculate the remaining time for a file transfer and settling on 'About 4 years'.
[Windows 11] Refusing to format a USB thumb drive because Windows suddenly discovered trust issues with FAT32.
[Windows 11] Setting execution policy to Bypass because life is too short to digitally sign local test scripts.
[Windows 11] Opening 8 invisible background processes named 'Antimalware Service Executable' to heat up the laptop chassis.

[Windows 11] Showing 'Diagnosing your PC' for 3 hours before concluding with 'Windows could not solve the problem'.
